def simulate_snake(board_size, snake, food, moves):
    """
    Simulates Snake game movements and returns final state after processing all moves.

    Args:
        board_size: Tuple (width, height) defining valid board bounds.
        snake: List of (x, y) tuples; head at index 0.
        food: List of (x, y) tuples; only first is active.
        moves: List of move strings ("UP", "DOWN", "LEFT", "RIGHT").

    Returns:
        Tuple: (final_snake, alive, food_eaten)
    """
    width, height = board_size

    # Current direction based on initial head and body movement
    current_dir = None

    def get_direction(dx, dy):
        if dx == 1: return "RIGHT"
        if dx == -1: return "LEFT"
        if dy == 1: return "DOWN"
        if dy == -1: return "UP"
        return None

    # Determine initial direction (from head to body)
    if len(snake) > 1:
        x_diff = snake[0][0] - snake[1][0]
        y_diff = snake[0][1] - snake[1][1]
        current_dir = get_direction(x_diff, y_diff)

    # Active food index
    active_food_idx = 0 if food else -1
    foods_eaten = 0

    for move in moves:
        dx, dy = 0, 0
        # Determine direction based on move string or current direction
        if move not in [current_dir] if current_dir else True:
            if move == "UP": dy = -1
            elif move == "DOWN": dy = 1
            elif move == "LEFT": dx = -1
            elif move == "RIGHT": dx = 1
        else:
            # Ignore opposite move
            if current_dir == "UP": continue
            elif current_dir == "DOWN": continue
            elif current_dir == "LEFT": continue
            elif current_dir == "RIGHT": continue

        # Compute new head position
        new_head = (snake[0][0] + dx, snake[0][1] + dy)

        # Check if within bounds
        if not (0 <= new_head[0] < width and 0 <= new_head[1] < height):
            return (list(snake), False, foods_eaten)

        # Check collision with body (excluding tail if it will move)
        body_parts = snake[:-1] if active_food_idx == 0 else snake
        for segment in body_parts:
            if new_head == segment:
                return (list(snake), False, foods_eaten)

        # Update snake position
        if active_food_idx != -1 and food[active_food_idx] == new_head:
            # Snake eats food — grow by keeping tail in place
            foods_eaten += 1
            if len(food) > active_food_idx + 1:
                active_food_idx += 1
            else:
                active_food_idx = -1  # All food consumed

        # Remove tail, insert new head (or keep tail if eating food)
        snake.insert(0, new_head)
        if not (active_food_idx == 0 and new_head == food[active_food_idx]):
            snake.pop()
        else:
            # Stayed at end after eating; no need to pop

    return (list(snake), True, foods_eaten)
